_description: Cross-SDK V2 bundle verification vectors (spec/VERIFICATION.md V2). Every verifier MUST accept signed_bundle. After applying the mutations of any must_reject case (set value at path, in order) it MUST reject it, whatever its verification mode, with an error that contains error_contains (case-insensitive). It MUST also reject every must_reject_bundles entry the same way, and give classical_only_routine_bundle the verdict in verified_by_mode. Every must_accept_bundles entry MUST verify in every mode. default_verifier_policy is the TypeScript DEFAULT_VERIFIER_POLICY; a verifier that takes a policy MUST accept it and verify signed_bundle under it.

classical_only_routine_bundle._description: Control for must_reject_bundles: the same classical-only, low-risk bundle with a routine intent. verified_by_mode is the expected verdict under each verification mode.
